limits: Did not rebuild packages or repeat measurements
1.5x diagnostic gate is not a claim of exact parity
method: Independent recomputation from raw worker observations, completed before publication. No timing or build was run by the reviewer.
verified_checks: Complete 102-case matrix for each of six rounds and two builds
All twelve worker CSVs match combined raw observations
Representation positions balanced twice per position
Complete result/missing/source hashes equal across builds and rounds
Before/after build receipts and controller identities equal
Current controller file hashes match measured identities
All CPU medians, compact/typed ratios, compact/ordinary ratios, paired-round median ratios and compact speedups recomputed
